scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true; bun tools/build-packages.ts --quiet
scripts.test:rust: bun tools/run-bounded.mjs --build cargo test -j 4 --workspace --offline --no-run && bun tools/run-bounded.mjs --test cargo test -j 4 --workspace --offline && bun tools/run-bounded.mjs --build cargo clippy -j 4 --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings
scripts.test:preview: bun run build --app counter && cargo build -j 4 -p zgui-host --locked --offline && bun test --isolate --timeout=30000 tests/preview/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:preview:ci: bun run build --app counter && cargo build -j 4 -p zgui-host --locked --offline && ZGUI_CI_SKIP_HARDWARE_BASELINE=1 bun test --isolate --timeout=30000 tests/preview/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:build && bun run test:rust && bun run test:vendor
